column7: parseCIDRs appended /32 to the input text of a bare IPv4-mapped trusted proxy, so ::ffff:1.2.3.4 became the IPv6 network ::/32 (trusting ::1 and every ::/32 peer to set X-Forwarded-For/X-Real-IP, which keys the per-IP rate limiter and the PAT/machine CIDR allowlist). Fixed by building the CIDR from the parsed address. Found by FuzzClientIPParsing (#4391), whose skip for this input class is removed
